failureClassification.directOutput: ynx-faucetd.service: Failed to execute /usr/local/bin/ynx-faucetd: Exec format error; status=203/EXEC
failureClassification.cause: The first candidate was built for macOS/arm64 and could not execute on the Linux/x86-64 production host.
failureClassification.remoteMutation: The candidate briefly replaced the binary and systemd attempted three starts.
failureClassification.recovery: The deployment gate restored the previous service binary and restarted it.

failureClassification.directOutput: The first SCP of the corrected Linux/x86-64 candidate was truncated.
failureClassification.remoteMutation: The install step did not run; the restored old service remained active.
failureClassification.recovery: A bounded resumable transfer completed and its remote SHA-256 was checked before install.

failureClassification.remoteMutation: Only ynx-faucetd was restarted; chain, gateway and Caddy services were not replaced.

rootCause.productionOutage: A prior funding timeout remained in the in-process lastError field. The old health implementation copied that stale error before probing the currently healthy upstream, so /health continued returning unhealthy.
rootCause.fix: CheckHealth now starts the current probe as healthy with an empty lastError and only reports an error when the current upstream status request fails.
